title: November ads, round one
intro: Everything here is a concept for round one. The videos are storyboard animatics that show each idea before we build the final version. Watch each one, then tap Approve, Maybe or No, and add a note if something should change. Your picks save automatically.

items.label: Reel
items.title: Nature Documentary
items.specs: 15 seconds, vertical for Reels and Stories, with a British narrator and music
fields: Here we observe the male golfer in his natural habitat. He has gathered his herd for the big game. Now the ritual begins. The herd will mock his slice for three straight hours. Book your bay at The Golffice.
Observe the golfer in his natural habitat.

Nature is beautiful when you see it up close. Watch the male golfer gather his herd for the big game, and then watch the herd roast his slice for three straight hours. Book your private bay in Birmingham, Huntsville or Madison at thegolffice.com.
